risk_summary: The disclosure presents material operating and real estate risks, including continuing losses, low cash generation, significant impairment charges, recessionary demand pressure, and oil-spill uncertainty. Liquidity is supported by $183.3 million of cash, an undrawn $125 million facility, and a $67.7 million tax refund, but strategic alternatives and litigation outcomes remain uncertain. Extensive forward-looking disclaimers and reliance on management estimates limit visibility into future performance.
